author: Mark-J153
quote:
Lost the overall essance of what it means to be a GTA game, GTA4 was a shining example, A single character alowing the player to get deep into the personalities that surround the protagonist, Nico had one of the best personalities in the GTA universe, Hardened tough man, soft and gentle, Solid moral compass and one tough son of a ****!
GTA4 had the perfect middle-ground between classic GTA and modern GTA.

GTA 5 was a little more hollow, Story spread across multiple characters made it feel rushed and gimmicky. But overall a solid 6 of 10 what should have guided GTA 6 to do better, but instead it has become technologically awesome and yet lost its entire mojo.

Genuinely, Rockstar needs to rethink a lot of the decisions made to sit on the fence and go back to the more "Southpark" style humor at its roots to make the game fun once more. With luck Rockstar will patch this sorry state into oblivion and we will yet still get the GTA Series we love back with a new spin on it, Or perhaps thats just me coping...

For now, Avoid if you are thinking about it.
